raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

With a block-outermost KV cache layout (`VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC`), all layers' pages of a block sit in one contiguous row. 
NIXL still registers one region per layer, so each block moves as one descriptor per layer (effectively rendering BL* useless). 

This PR registers the row once, fixing registration back to its intended use.

Example: GLM-5.3-NVFP4, TP4, BLHNC. Input to `register_kv_caches` on rank 0 is 99 views over one 43.8 GB storage:

```
model.layers.0.self_attn.indexer.k_cache  (14323, 1, 64, 132)  stride(0)=3059712  offset 0
model.layers.0.self_attn.attn             (14323, 1, 64, 576)  stride(0)=3059712  offset 177408
...

row b: [ idx L0 | idx L1 | ... | mla L0 | mla L1 | ... | mla L77 ]   3059712 B
```

**Before** (`elif storage_is_block_major:` branch), each view is its own region:

```
region 0:  base S + 177408, block_len 36864, stride 3059712   # layers.0.attn
region 1:  base S + 0,      block_len 8448,  stride 3059712   # layers.0.indexer
...
-> 99 regions, 99 x 14323 = 1.42M descriptors; a 2-block request = 198 descriptors
```

**After** (the existing whole-row branch, previously push-only), every view emits the same region and dedup folds them into one:

```
region 0:  base S, block_len 3059712, stride 3059712           # whole row, all layers
-> 1 region, 14323 descriptors; a 2-block request = 2 descriptors
```

### HiSparse

A HiSparse decoder can't register rows: its MLA cache is in host DRAM and its indexer on GPU, so it keeps per-layer regions LB*. 
P can still advertise each layer's `(offset, page_size)` within the row (BL*).
When the peer is per-layer, `_split_remote_packed_rows` (added with this PR) maps P's row onto the peer's per-layer regions.
 
BLHNC P + HiSparse D therefore works as before, with the same descriptor count as `main`.
cc @LucasWilkinson the alternative is to enforce P also uses LB* here, not sure if there's disadvantages (considering .

Out of scope: GQA spec-decode drafts under an MLA target, deferred to #60564.

## Test Plan

- Unit: `pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_desc_geometry.py test_nixl_connector.py test_nixl_connector_hma.py test_nixl_push_connector.py`
  - `test_packed_mla_pp1_transfers_whole_rows` now covers pull and push and asserts 1 region / 1 descriptor per block, guarding against falling back to per-layer regions again.
  - New tests for the row split and for the mismatched-rows error.
- E2E, GLM-5.3-NVFP4, P TP4 -> D TP4 on 8xB200, NixlConnector pull, `tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --num-questions 500` (5-shot) through `toy_proxy_server.py`.

## Test Result

- Unit: 593 passed across the four suites. On `main`, the new pull-mode cases of `test_packed_mla_pp1_transfers_whole_rows` fail (per-layer regions); with this PR they pass.

| P -> D | regions P / D | gsm8k | NIXL transfers | avg descriptors / transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BLHNC -> BLHNC | 1 / 1 (99 / 99 on main) | 0.912 | 1040, 0 failed | 1.2 |
| BLHNC -> HiSparse D (default layout) | 1 / 99 | 0.918 | 685, 0 failed | 45.9 |

## Related PRs

#60851 and #60564 target the same descriptor blow-up. #60564 puts whole rows behind an opt-in `whole_row_regions` flag that must be set on both P and D, and rejects HiSparse. Here it is the default for BLHNC, needs no flag, and HiSparse decoders keep working. 

#60564 also handles GQA draft head-sharding, which this PR leaves to it.

         # One layer per region keeps a second alignment pass a no-op.
         nixl_agent_meta.region_members = [[name] for name in self._transfer_layer_names]
 
+    def _split_remote_packed_rows(self, nixl_agent_meta: NixlAgentMetadata) -> None:
+        """Map the remote's whole-row region onto our per-layer regions.
+
+        E.g. a BLHNC prefiller registers one region whose block is a full row
+        holding every layer's page, while a HiSparse decoder registers one
+        region per layer. Using the advertised `packed_member_layouts`, the
+        remote row is rewritten in place as one virtual region per local layer:
+
+            remote row b:  [ L0 page | L1 page | ... ]   base=B, stride=S
+                             ^off0     ^off1
+
+            remote metadata, before:  [(B, S, S)]               # (base, len, stride)
+            remote metadata, after:   [(B + off0, page0, S),    # L0
+                                       (B + off1, page1, S)]    # L1
+
+        Remote regions outside the row (e.g. a separate indexer) pass through.
+        """
+        layouts = nixl_agent_meta.packed_member_layouts
+        remote_names = nixl_agent_meta.region_names
+        assert remote_names is not None, "Remote advertised no region_names"
+        (row,) = [i for i, name in enumerate(remote_names) if name in layouts]
+        if nixl_agent_meta.region_group_ids is not None and (
+            nixl_agent_meta.region_group_ids[row] == _SHARED_REGION_GROUP_ID
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Reading multi-group packed KV rows into per-layer regions is not "
+                "supported; use the same KV cache layout on P and D."
+            )
+        remote_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(remote_names)}
+        regions = [
+            (row, *layouts[name])
+            if name in layouts
+            else (remote_index[name], 0, nixl_agent_meta.block_lens[remote_index[name]])
+            for name in self.region_names
+        ]
+        nixl_agent_meta.kv_caches_base_addr = [
+            nixl_agent_meta.kv_caches_base_addr[i] + offset for i, offset, _ in regions
+        ]
